mapper.select: select m.TOPIC_ID as topicId, t.NAME as topicName, count(*) as msgs, ifnull(sum(length(m.CONTENT)), 0) as textBytes, min(m.SEND_TIME) as firstAt, max(m.SEND_TIME) as lastAt from topic_chat_message m left join forum_topic t on t.TOPIC_ID = m.TOPIC_ID group by m.TOPIC_ID, t.NAME order by count(*) desc
